marks.gloss_en: R' Yitzchak ben Elyashiv: liquid mud proves it -- it combines toward the forty se'ah, yet one who immerses in it has not immersed
a large reed mat made for lying on is susceptible to impurity
אמרת: עשאה לשכיבה... טעמא דעשאה לשכיבה, הא סתמא לסיכוך
the stam: the reason [it is unfit] is that he made it for lying -- so an undesignated one is for roofing
והדר תני: לסיכוך מסככין בה... טעמא דעשאה לסיכוך, הא סתמא לשכיבה
הא גופה קשיא: from the reisha an undesignated mat is for roofing, והדר תני ... הא סתמא לשכיבה! (internal contradiction in the mishna; kind svara under protest)
the stam: the reason [it is fit] is that he made it for roofing -- so an undesignated one is for lying
רבי אליעזר אומר: אחת קטנה ואחת גדולה עשאה לשכיבה... הא סתמא לסיכוך
the stam, on R' Eliezer: the reason is that he made it for lying -- so an undesignated one, small or large, is for roofing
אימא סיפא: עשאה לסיכוך... הא סתמא לשכיבה
(בשלמא לרבנן לא קשיא, אלא לרבי אליעזר קשיא) -- R' Eliezer's reisha implies undesignated is for roofing, אימא סיפא ... הא סתמא לשכיבה!
the stam, on R' Eliezer's seifa: the reason is that he made it for roofing -- so an undesignated one is for lying
הא לא קשיא: כאן בגדולה, כאן בקטנה (= p_kan_bigdola, p_kan_biktana)
the stam's answer: here [the reisha] -- a large mat: undesignated, it is for roofing

אלא אמר רבא: in a large mat all agree undesignated is for roofing; they dispute a small one (= p_rava_gedola_kulei_alma, p_rava_pligi_biktana and his reports). Felled by Abaye's two objections (20a.2-3)
Rava: regarding a large mat everyone agrees that undesignated it is for roofing
מאי טעמייהו דרבנן? שיפועי אהלים כאהלים דמו -- the slope is itself a tent (roof)
שיפועי אהלים כאהלים דמו -- likewise for the sukkah leaned on a wall
the slopes of tents are like tents
דתניא: ... רבי נתן אומר רבי אליעזר פוסל ... וחכמים מכשירין -- the mishna's wording is R' Natan's report (kind tanya_kevatei: no kind names a bare דתניא)
מתניתין יחידאה היא -- the mishna's version is R' Natan's alone, as the baraita shows (= p_matnitin_yechidaah)
Rav Yosef: the mishna is a lone [tanna's] version -- R' Natan's
כמאן — כרבי אליעזר? שבקת רבנן ועבדת כרבי אליעזר! -- you left the Sages and acted like R' Eliezer
Rav Yosef slept in a bridal canopy inside the sukkah
ברייתא איפכא תני: רבי אליעזר מכשיר וחכמים פוסלין -- on the baraita's version my practice follows the Sages (= p_baraita_ipcha)
שבקת מתניתין ועבדת כברייתא? -- you left the mishna and acted like a baraita?
Rav Yosef: the baraita teaches the reverse -- R' Eliezer validates and the Sages invalidate
a sukkah made like a sloping hut (tzrif) is invalid
R' Eliezer concedes: if he raised it a handbreadth off the ground, it is valid
